title: Efficient and Scalable Gene Delivery Method with Cationic Carbon Dots
author: Algarra, Gonzalez-Muñoz
materials: HEK293T cell line was obtained from Sigma Aldridch (#12022001). Primary somatic stromal cell lines MenSC (also called MnSC) were previously generated after donor informed consent and with clearances from the bioethical committee and Review Board of the National Research Ethics Service (#PR-03–2018) [27]. HEK293T cells were cultured with high glucose in DMEM (with 10% FBS, 1% glutamine and 1% penicillin–streptomycin). MenSC cells were cultured in DMEM-F12 containing 10%FBS, 1xNEAA, 1xL-Glutamine, penicillin and streptomycin as previously described [27, 28]. We followed standard transient transfection using the PEI method as previously described [28] or generated CCDs as described in the results "Effect of CDs on cell viability" section. For retroviral production, HEK293T cells were plated at 70% cell confluence in 100 mm dishes. After 24 h, cells were transfected with a transgene encoding the pMX viral vector, Gag-Pol vector and VSV-G plasmid using either the polyethylenimine method or generated CCD particles. The supernatant was collected 24 h posttransfection and filtered through 45-mm pore size filters. Cell transduction was performed on HEK293T or MenSC cells using 2 mL of unconcentrated viral supernatant to transduce 100,000 cells in the presence of 4 μg/mL polybrene.

steps.title: Synthesize carbon dots via hydrothermal method
steps.instruction: Dissolve citric acid to a concentration of 50 g/L in water, transfer the solution into a Teflon‑lined beaker placed inside a steel reactor, heat at 200 °C for 4 h, allow the reactor to cool to room temperature (25 °C), centrifuge the reaction mixture to remove insoluble material, and dialyze the supernatant for 24 h to obtain purified carbon dots.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 50 g/L aqueous citric acid solution.
Transfer solution to Teflon‑lined beaker in steel reactor.
Heat at 200 °C for 4 h in an oven.
Dialyze the cleared suspension for 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare cell culture media
steps.instruction: For HEK293T cells, use high‑glucose DMEM supplemented with 10 % FBS, 1 % glutamine, and 1 % penicillin–streptomycin; for MenSC cells, use DMEM‑F12 supplemented with 10 % FBS, 1× NEAA, 1× L‑Glutamine, penicillin and streptomycin.

steps.title: Transiently transfect HEK293T cells (PEI)
steps.instruction: Apply the standard polyethyleneimine (PEI) transient transfection protocol, as previously described, to HEK293T cells cultured in the prepared high‑glucose DMEM medium.

steps.title: Produce retroviral particles
steps.instruction: Plate HEK293T cells at approximately 70 % confluence in 100 mm dishes; after 24 h, transfect with the pMX viral vector, Gag‑Pol plasmid, and VSV‑G plasmid using either PEI or the generated CCD particles; incubate for another 24 h, then collect the supernatant and filter it through a 45‑mm pore‑size filter.

substeps.instruction: Plate HEK293T cells at ~70 % confluence in 100 mm dishes.
After 24 h, transfect with pMX, Gag‑Pol, and VSV‑G plasmids using PEI or CCD particles.
Filter supernatant through a 45‑mm pore‑size filter.

steps.title: Transduce target cells with viral supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of the unconcentrated viral supernatant to 100 000 target cells (HEK293T or MenSC) in the presence of 4 µg/mL polybrene and incubate under standard culture conditions.

steps.title: Analyze GFP expression by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Harvest cells at 300 × g for 5 min, fix in 4 % v/v formaldehyde for 15 min, centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min, resuspend the pellet in 0.3 mL PBS, run samples on a Beckman Coulter Gallios cytometer using a 488 nm laser (FITC‑A detector) acquiring 100 000 events, gate SSC‑H vs FSC‑A and FSC‑A vs FSC‑H to select single cells, then assess GFP‑positive cells on a FITC vs FSC‑A plot using a negative control, and analyze data with Kaluza software.

substeps.instruction: Harvest cells at 300 × g for 5 min.
Fix cells in 4 % v/v formaldehyde for 15 min.
Acquire 100 000 events on a Beckman Coulter Gallios cytometer (488 nm laser, FITC‑A detector).
Gate SSC‑H vs FSC‑A and FSC‑A vs FSC‑H to isolate single cells.
Identify GFP‑positive population on FITC vs FSC‑A plot using a negative control.
